title: Zesty Irish Salmon Pudding
description: A peppery and velvety Irish dish featuring salmon, muscovado sugar, and a poaching method, this keto-friendly recipe is a quick fix for a delicious meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, muscovado sugar, and unsalted butter, and heat over medium heat until the sugar has dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the chopped fresh dill, black pepper, and salt.
Place the salmon fillets in a large baking dish and pour the cream mixture over the top of the salmon.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and poach the salmon in the oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through.
Remove the salmon from the oven and stir in the lemon juice.
Serve the salmon pudding hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
